description: List the datasets within a statistical domain (use a domain id from list_domains). Returns a JSON-stat collection; each item has extension.id (the dataset id, a hex string) and extension.num_series. The dataset id feeds get_dataset. lang defaults to PT.

domain_id.description: Domain id from list_domains, e.g. 3 (Balança de pagamentos).

name: list_datasets
title: List Datasets
